name: InventoryAdjustment
description: A transaction that changes the quantity of inventory items for reasons such as damage, stock write-off, shrinkage, or expiration, automatically handling the underlying accounting and valuation.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken, and sparse must be set to true.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object, used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Required for update.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. yyyy/MM/dd is the valid date format. For posting transactions, this is the posting date that affects the financial statements. If the date is not supplied, the current date on the server is used. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of an inventory adjustment.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: The type of line detail. For inventory adjustments this is ItemAdjustmentLineDetail.

attributes.name: ItemAdjustmentLineDetail
attributes.description: Details of the inventory item adjustment for this line.

attributes.name: QtyDiff
attributes.description: The change in quantity for the inventory item (can be negative).

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory item being adjusted.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The display name of the referenced item.

fields.name: AdjustAccountRef
fields.description: Specifies which account is debited. Query the Account name list resource to determine the appropriate Account object for this reference. Use Account.Id and Account.Name from that object for AdjustAccountRef.value and AdjustAccountRef.name, respectively.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the referenced account.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction. Required for create.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction. This note does not appear on the invoice to the customer. This field maps to the Statement Memo field on the Invoice form in the QuickBooks Online UI.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated.
